meta.title: The Book of Common Prayer (1979), The Great Litany

sources.ref: The Book of Common Prayer: E-text Edition (American, 1979), Version 1.0, 13 December 1993, The Great Litany, printed pages 148 to 157
sources.note: Spoken responses are marked with =...= in the e-text and split into people lines here. Wording was corrected against the official Church online BCP at bcponline.org.

caveats: Section headings are app aids for navigation, not printed rubrics.
Speaker attribution follows the printed responsorial structure; the 1979 book does not print Minister and People labels in the Great Litany.

E-text transcription typos and four substantive e-text divergences (Holy Ghost in the Invocation and Deprecation, no doxology in the Lord's Prayer, thy Name in the Supplication collect) are corrected to the printed 1979 wording.
The alternative Kyrie form and the appended Supplication are retained as printed.

lines.text: The Deprecation

Remember not, Lord Christ, our offenses, nor the offenses of our forefathers; neither reward us according to our sins. Spare us, good Lord, spare thy people, whom thou hast redeemed with thy most precious blood, and by thy mercy preserve us, for ever.

lines.speaker: people

lines.text: From all evil and wickedness; from sin; from the crafts and assaults of the devil; and from everlasting damnation,

lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.

lines.speaker: officiant

lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: In all time of our tribulation; in all time of our prosperity; in the hour of death, and in the day of judgment,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: Good Lord, deliver us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: The Supplication
We sinners do beseech thee to hear us, O Lord God; and that it may please thee to rule and govern thy holy Church Universal in the right way,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to illumine all bishops, priests, and deacons, with true knowledge and understanding of thy Word; and that both by their preaching and living, they may set it forth, and show it accordingly,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to bless and keep all thy people,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to send forth laborers into thy harvest, and to draw all mankind into thy kingdom,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give to all people increase of grace to hear and receive thy Word, and to bring forth the fruits of the Spirit,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to bring into the way of truth all such as have erred, and are deceived,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give us a heart to love and fear thee, and diligently to live after thy commandments,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee so to rule the hearts of thy servants, the President of the United States (or of this nation), and all others in authority, that they may do justice, and love mercy, and walk in the ways of truth,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to make wars to cease in all the world; to give to all nations unity, peace, and concord; and to bestow freedom upon all peoples,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to show thy pity upon all prisoners and captives, the homeless and the hungry, and all who are desolate and oppressed,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give and preserve to our use the bountiful fruits of the earth, so that in due time all may enjoy them,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to inspire us, in our several callings, to do the work which thou givest us to do with singleness of heart as thy servants, and for the common good,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to preserve all who are in danger by reason of their labor or their travel,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to preserve, and provide for, all women in childbirth, young children and orphans, the widowed, and all whose homes are broken or torn by strife,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to visit the lonely; to strengthen all who suffer in mind, body, and spirit; and to comfort with thy presence those who are failing and infirm,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to support, help, and comfort all who are in danger, necessity, and tribulation,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to have mercy upon all mankind,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to give us true repentance; to forgive us all our sins, negligences, and ignorances; and to endue us with the grace of thy Holy Spirit to amend our lives according to thy holy Word,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to forgive our enemies, persecutors, and slanderers, and to turn their hearts,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to strengthen such as do stand; to comfort and help the weak-hearted; to raise up those who fall; and finally to beat down Satan under our feet,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to grant to all the faithful departed eternal life and peace,
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: That it may please thee to grant that, in the fellowship of [_____ and] all the saints, we may attain to thy heavenly kingdom,

lines.text: When the Litany is sung or said immediately before the Eucharist, the Litany concludes here, and the Eucharist begins with the Salutation and the Collect of the Day.
On all other occasions, the Officiant and People say together
The Lord’s Prayer

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy Name, thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: O Lord, let thy mercy be showed upon us;
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: As we do put our trust in thee.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: The Officiant concludes with the following or some other Collect
The Collect

Let us pray. Almighty God, who hast promised to hear the petitions of those who ask in thy Son's Name: We beseech thee mercifully to incline thine ear to us who have now made our prayers and supplications unto thee; and grant that those things which we have asked faithfully according to thy will, may be obtained effectually, to the relief of our necessity, and to the setting forth of thy glory; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: The Officiant may add other Prayers, and end the Litany, saying
The Grace
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Ghost, be with us all evermore. Amen.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: A Supplication for Times of Trouble

For use in the Litany in place of the Versicle and Collect which follows the Lord's Prayer; or at the end of Morning or Evening Prayer; or as a separate devotion; especially in times of war, or of national anxiety, or of disaster.
O Lord, arise, help us;
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: And deliver us for thy Name's sake.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: O God, we have heard with our ears, and our fathers have declared unto us, the noble works that thou didst in their days, and in the old time before them.
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: O Lord, arise, help us; and deliver us for thy Name's sake.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: O Lord, arise, help us; and deliver us for thy Name's sake.
lines.speaker: all

lines.text: From our enemies defend us, O Christ;
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.speaker: people

lines.speaker: officiant

lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Favorably with mercy hear our prayers;
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: O Son of David, have mercy upon us.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: Both now and ever vouchsafe to hear us, O Christ;
lines.speaker: officiant

lines.text: Graciously hear us, O Christ; graciously hear us, O Lord Christ.
lines.speaker: people

lines.text: The Officiant concludes

Let us pray. We humbly beseech thee, O Father, mercifully to look upon our infirmities; and, for the glory of thy Name, turn from us all those evils that we most justly have deserved; and grant that in all our troubles we may put our whole trust and confidence in thy mercy, and evermore serve thee in holiness and pureness of living, to thy honor and glory; through our only Mediator and Advocate, Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
lines.speaker: officiant
